rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an object's external surface or a general flat surface.

example.english: There is some water on the surface of the table.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 biu2 min6 jau5 di1 seoi2

rows.note: Use this casual noun for the top or upper side of a flat object, often with the object named before it.

example.english: There is a coffee stain on the surface of the table.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 min6 jau5 gaa3 fe1 zik1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the surface of water.

example.english: The moonlight shining on the surface of the water is beautiful.
example.jyutping: jyut6 gwong1 ziu3 zyu6 seoi2 min6 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this for a person's or thing's outward appearance rather than its physical surface.

example.english: If you only look at the surface, you may not be able to tell what kind of person they are.
example.traditional: 淨係睇外表，未必睇得出佢係咩人。
example.jyutping: zing6 hai6 tai2 ngoi6 biu2 mei6 bit1 tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 hai6 me1 jan4
